g.text: ESPACIO Platform (AWS QA & PROD — High Availability)
AWS ALB / Nginx Multi-AZ Load Balancer
Spring Cloud Gateway: Strict CORS, Rate Limit,
JWT Relay, Security Headers, Correlation IDs
Zero direct public access to backend pods
• Polyglot 4 DBs: MySQL, Mongo, Redis, Vector DB
Isolated DBs, Keycloak realms, Sentry projects,
Grounded RAG + Read-only MCP Tool Server
Sentry.io: FE + BE errors, traces & releases
Site24x7: QA/PROD uptime, SSL & latency alerts
Automated Slack/Email alerts on SLA breach
C4 Level 1 Architectural Delta Summary (GPWP-38 / ARCH-09)
1. Edge Protection (Cloudflare): All public traffic for QA & PROD terminates at Cloudflare WAF/DNS before reaching AWS ALB.
2. Ingress Governance (ALB + API Gateway): Load Balancer distributes across HA replicas; Spring Cloud Gateway enforces CORS & rate limits.
3. PaaS & AI Ecosystem: Explicitly incorporates Headless CMS PaaS (Strapi/Contentful/Supabase) and LLM/VLM + Vector DB RAG.
4. Observability-Driven Operations: Sentry.io captures frontend/backend traces & errors; Site24x7 monitors QA & PROD availability 24/7.
5. RBAC Expansion: Supports ROLE_TENANT, ROLE_LANDLORD, and ROLE_ADMIN with zero direct backend exposure.
